sgen1.name: sgen1
sgen1.authors_source: author's page (eeecs.qub.ac.uk/~I.Spence/sgen) and the header of sgen1.c
sgen1.license_note: no licence in the source nor on the page: ask the author before publishing the image
sgen1.seed: -s, default 1; the generator uses its own linear congruential generator
sgen1.notes: main() always returns 1, even on success; the verifier ignores the exit status and checks the output instead

cnfgen.name: CNFgen
cnfgen.usage: cnfgen FAMILY PARAMETERS...; cnfgen --help lists the families
cnfgen.seed: random families take a seed option; Python's random module does not promise identical draws across Python versions

lockchart.name: lockchart-to-cnf
lockchart.authors_source: repository nrilu/lockchart-to-cnf and the SAT Competition 2025 benchmark description
lockchart.seed: none; with -r the lock-chart is randomised from the clock and cannot be reproduced
lockchart.notes: the script draws the lock-chart after writing the formula, which needs LaTeX and fails in the image; the formula is already complete at that point

oddball.name: Oddball
oddball.authors_source: repository acmihal/oddball and the SAT Competition 2025 benchmark description
oddball.license_note: the repository declares no licence: the recipe is published, the image is not, until the author agrees
oddball.seed: none; the formula is built through z3 and is deterministic
